title: Agent Benchmark — Architecture Review
description: Architecture review derived from ai-artifacts/agent-reliability-benchmark/review/architecture.md: blockers, smallest fixes (Phase 0..1), persistence/outbox/R2 ordering, unknown_after_send handling, rollout sequence, deferred complexity, and final verdict.

blockers.why_blocker: System records task completion before a canonical durable result or delivery intent is persisted; no canonical object to read for retries/reconciliations.
blockers.minimal_fix: Persist a canonical result record and enqueue durable delivery intent before marking task 'completed' or destroying the Sandbox.

blockers.why_blocker: No per-channel delivery state (attempt_count, provider_message_id, unknown_after_send) persisted; sends are thin wrappers and do not persist provider evidence.
blockers.minimal_fix: Add task_delivery table, persist provider_message_id and final delivery state in task_delivery, and implement a delivery consumer that persists evidence before acking queue messages.

blockers.why_blocker: Attachments are staged in Sandbox and destroyed immediately after completion, losing artifact bytes referenced by persisted results.
blockers.minimal_fix: Copy required files to R2 and record artifact_manifest before destroying Sandbox; only destroy after result was persisted.

phase0.step: Modify completeGeneralTask to persist result and copy files to R2 before marking completed
Create task_delivery row(s) and enqueue delivery Queue message instead of direct send
Implement delivery consumer to call Telegram and persist provider evidence
phase0.files_to_edit: src/tasks/delivery.ts or extend src/cloudflare.ts queue consumer

phase0.step: Expose a trusted /resend handler to enqueue delivery intents (no re-run of Flue)

verdict.notes: Must persist result + copy files + enqueue delivery intents before marking completed
Use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guards; deploy readers before writers
Ensure R2 copy before delete; add TTL and retention policy

props.content:
Persistence and outbox ordering (explicit):
1) Persist canonical task_result (task_id, result_version, artifact_manifest) and copy any files to R2.  
2) Create durable delivery intent(s) in task_delivery (state=pending) and enqueue delivery queue message.  
3) Only after the above succeed, mark task.completed and destroy Sandbox.  
Evidence: recommended in review/architecture.md Phase 0 steps and code references (src/tools/task-tools.ts:348-446; src/durable-objects/task-ledger.ts:1518-1529).

unknown_after_send handling: on ambiguous outcomes (network timeout after provider acceptance or Worker crash before persisting provider evidence), set delivery.state = 'unknown_after_send', surface to operator UI, and do not auto-replay. Add manual operator dedupe guidance and a small policy to retry transient 5xx/429 using Retry-After. (See review/architecture.md notes on provider-side duplication risk and 'unknown_after_send'.)

props.content: Overengineering and deferred items (explicitly deferred in the review): do NOT adopt a second runtime, Workflows, or full workspace snapshotting as part of this Phase 0. Consider a separate DELIVERY queue only if delivery starvation is observed (deferred).

props.caption: Final verdict and acceptance gate summary

props.content: Final verdict: The report's minimal target architecture is correct: add task_results, add durable outbox (task_delivery), copy artifacts to R2 before Sandbox teardown, and implement a delivery consumer. Execute Phase 0 immediately (persist result before completion, copy files to R2, enqueue durable delivery intents). These changes are additive and compatible with the existing Durable Object migration pattern.
